name: hush
description: The Hush: a wordless vector metroidvania for the browser.

scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/sim tests/rooms tests/audio tests/clock tests/input tests/fx tests/render tests/game
scripts.probe:console: vite build && node tools/probe-play.mjs --check console,play,text && node tools/probe-play.mjs --channel edge --headed --check console,play,text
scripts.accept:game: vite build && node tools/probe-play.mjs --check console,play,text,visibility,unlock,keys && tsc --noEmit && eslint src
scripts.accept:rn1: vitest run tests/render/room-art.test.mjs tests/render/draw-shapes.test.mjs && npm run check:art
scripts.accept:rn2: vitest run tests/render/creature.test.mjs && npm run check:art
scripts.accept:rn3: vitest run tests/render/beat-art.test.mjs && npm run check:art
scripts.accept:rn4: vitest run tests/render/depth-art.test.mjs tests/render/play-frame.test.mjs && npm run check:art
scripts.accept:ending: vitest run tests/render/ending-art.test.mjs && vite build && node tools/probe-play.mjs --check console,play,text,scene,again
scripts.check:art: vite build && node tools/probe-flash.mjs && node tools/probe-perf.mjs --headed
